baseline_and_shortcuts.policy: Category + side, goal-only, guard/event cue, shallow rules, action-frequency, counterfactual irrelevant-field and role-relabel tests must pass on actual admitted AST before design GO; a weak baseline alone does not prove novelty.
baseline_and_shortcuts.prior_category_side_baseline: 10/32 old OOD sides inherited, not rerun
baseline_and_shortcuts.prior_shallow_source_baseline: 64/64 old sides against prior receipt, inherited not rerun

eval_rights_private_custody.unseal_order: Prereg+design GO, rights, custodian, private EVAL freeze with HMAC and source provenance, independent nonoverlap signed audit, parser/model/output SHA freeze, blind scoring, authorized postlock unseal; no post-outcome replacements.

renderer_parser_T1.guard: Never render split, IDs, provenance, gold, oracle fields or truth labels; test cue balance after formal AST admission.
